graph.name: CLAP Automated Sports Video Editing Architecture
graph.notes: Automated video processing pipeline built on AWS by CLAP to ingest high-definition sports streams, extract frames, execute parallel AI inference for feature detection, assemble clip edits, and deliver finalized highlights to streaming platforms.

nodes.name: Video Input
nodes.notes: High-definition video feed ingest (50 Mbps, ~50 GB for a 2-hour sports match).

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores raw input videos, extracted PNG frame images, and detection metadata.

nodes.name: STEP FUNCTION
nodes.notes: Orchestrates the sequential 4-step video analysis and compilation pipeline.

nodes.name: Frame Extraction Lambda
nodes.notes: Extracts thousands of video frames into PNG format and stores them in S3.

nodes.name: Batch Dispatcher Lambda
nodes.notes: Lists extracted frames and dispatches batch processing jobs (50-200 frames per batch).

nodes.name: Parallel Inference Lambda
nodes.notes: Executes parallel computer vision inference using TensorFlow models across up to 1,000 concurrent Lambda functions.

nodes.name: Decision Engine Lambda
nodes.notes: Analyzes detected features (e.g., ball position, goal events) to determine highlight edit points.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Orchestrates long-running FFmpeg video transcoding and editing container tasks.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: Provides underlying compute host capacity for the ECS cluster tasks.

nodes.name: STREAMING PLATFORM
nodes.notes: External streaming platforms that deliver compiled highlight videos to end users.

edges.notes: High-bitrate video stream uploaded to S3 bucket.
Video arrival automatically triggers Step Functions execution workflow.
Step Functions invokes Frame Extraction Lambda.
Step Functions invokes Batch Dispatcher Lambda.
Batch Dispatcher launches parallel inference Lambda tasks for frame batches.
Step Functions invokes Decision Engine Lambda.
Step Functions triggers ECS video editing execution.
ECS runs container workload on EC2 instances.
Edited video highlights pushed to destination streaming platforms.
